workflow:
  name: karta-ref-group
  resources:
    default:
      cpu: 1
      memory: 512Mi
      storage: 1Gi
      platform: reference-cpu
  groups:
  - name: pair
    ignoreNonleadStatus: false
    tasks:
    - name: leader
      lead: true
      image: docker.io/library/ubuntu@sha256:68ee22004a9109b44973313b02ff7b1de250f1de0f5ecb628d73f579aaff33ac
      command: [/bin/sh, -c]
      args: ["echo reference-leader-start; sleep 240; echo reference-leader-done"]
    - name: worker
      image: docker.io/library/ubuntu@sha256:68ee22004a9109b44973313b02ff7b1de250f1de0f5ecb628d73f579aaff33ac
      command: [/bin/sh, -c]
      args: ["echo reference-worker-start; sleep 230; echo reference-worker-done"]
